1.text: Kōra mwene Isuhari wa Kohati wa Lewi, agomana na Datani na Abiramu bene Eliyabu, na Oni mwene Peleti bo mu Barubeni.

2.text: Bahagurukira Mose bafatanije na bamwe mu Bisirayeli, abatware b'iteraniro magana abiri na mirongo itanu bajya bahamagarwa mu iteraniro, ibimenywabose.

3.text: Bateranira kugomera Mose na Aroni, barababwira bati “Ibyo mukora birahagije kuko abo mu iteraniro bose ari abera: umuntu wese wo muri bo, Uwiteka akaba hagati muri bo. Nuko ni iki gituma mwishyira hejuru y'iteraniro ry'Uwiteka?”

5.text: Abwira Kōra n'abafatanije na we bose ati “Ejo mu gitondo Uwiteka azerekana abe abo ari bo, n'uwera uwo ari we amwiyigize hafi. Uwo azatoranya ni we aziyigiza hafi.

6.text: Mugenze mutya: mwende ibyotero, Kōra n'abo mufatanije mwese,

7.text: ejo muzabishyiremo umuriro, muwushyirireho imibavu imbere y'Uwiteka, umuntu Uwiteka azatoranya, azaba ari uwera. Ibyo mukora birahagije mwa Balewi mwe.”

8.text: Kandi Mose abwira Kōra ati “Nimwumve Balewi:

9.text: mbese mwarabisuzuguye yuko Imana y'Abisirayeli yabarobanuriye mu iteraniro ry'Abisirayeli kubiyegereza hafi, ngo mukore imirimo yo mu buturo bw'Uwiteka, muhagarare imbere y'iteraniro mubakorere?

10.text: Nawe Kōra, ikakwiyigizanya hafi na bene wanyu Abalewi bose, none murashaka n'ubutambyi?

11.text: Icyo ni cyo gitumye wowe n'abo mufatanije mwese muteranira kugomera Uwiteka. Aroni ni iki, ko mumwitotombera?”

12.text: Mose ahamagaza Datani na Abiramu, baravuga bati “Ntabwo twitaba.

13.text: Aho uragira ngo biroroshye kudukura mu gihugu cy'amata n'ubuki ukatwicira mu butayu, kandi ugakubitaho no kwigira umutware wacu?

14.text: Kandi ntutujyanye mu gihugu cy'amata n'ubuki, ntuduhaye gakondo y'imirima n'inzabibu. Mbese urashaka kumena amaso y'aba bantu? Ntituri bwitabe.”

15.text: Mose ararakara cyane abwira Uwiteka ati “Ntiwite ku maturo yabo: sinabanyaze n'indogobe imwe, nta n'umwe muri bo nagiriye nabi.”

16.text: Mose abwira Kōra ati “Ejo wowe n'iteraniro ryawe ryose muzazane imbere y'Uwiteka, wowe na bo na Aroni.

17.text: Umuntu wese muri mwe azende icyotero cye agishyireho umubavu, mwese mubizane imbere y'Uwiteka uko ari magana abiri na mirongo itanu, nawe ubwawe na Aroni muzane ibyotero byanyu.”

18.text: Umuntu wese muri bo yenda icyotero cye agishyiramo umuriro, awushyiraho umubavu bahagararana na Mose na Aroni ku muryango w'ihema ry'ibonaniro.

19.text: Kōra ateraniriza iteraniro ryose ku muryango w'ihema ry'ibonaniro kubagomera. Ubwiza bw'Uwiteka bubonekera iteraniro ryose.

20.text: Uwiteka abwira Mose na Aroni ati

21.text: “Nimwitandukanirize n'iri teraniro kugira ngo ndirimbure mu kanya gato.”

22.text: Bikubita hasi bubamye baravuga bati “Mana, Mana y'imyuka y'abafite umubiri bose, umuntu umwe nakora icyaha, mbese urarakarira iteraniro ryose?”

24.text: “Bwira iteraniro uti ‘Nimuhaguruke muve impande zose z'ubuturo bwa Kōra na Datani na Abiramu.’ ”

25.text: Mose arahaguruka ajya aho Datani na Abiramu bari, abakuru bo mu Bisirayeli baramukurikira.

26.text: Abwira iteraniro ati “Nimuve ku mahema y'aba banyabyaha, ntimugire ikintu cyabo mukoraho, kugira ngo igihano bahanirwa ibyaha byabo byose kitabarimburana na bo.”

27.text: Barahaguruka bava impande zose z'ubuturo bwa Kōra na Datani na Abiramu.Datani na Abiramu barasohoka, bahagararana mu miryango y'amahema yabo n'abagore babo, n'abahungu babo n'abana babo bato.

28.text: Mose aravuga ati “Iki ni cyo kiri bubamenyeshe yuko Uwiteka yantumye gukora imirimo nkora yose, kandi yuko ntagize icyo nkora ku bwanjye.

29.text: Aba bantu nibapfa urupfu rwa bose, nibaba icyo abandi bantu bose baba, Uwiteka ari bube atantumye.

30.text: Ariko Uwiteka nakora ikintu cy'inzaduka, ubutaka bukasama bukabamirana n'ababo n'ibyabo byose, bakarigita ikuzimu bakiri bazima, muri bumenye yuko aba bantu basuzuguye Uwiteka.”

31.text: Akimara kuvuga ayo magambo yose, ubutaka buri munsi yabo bugabanywamo kabiri,

32.text: nuko burasama, bubamirana n'ab'amazu yabo, n'abantu ba Kōra bose n'ibintu byabo byose.

33.text: Nuko bo n'ababo n'ibyabo byose barigita ikuzimu bakiri bazima, ubutaka bubarengaho, bararimbuka bakurwa mu iteraniro.

34.text: Abisirayeli babagose bose bahungishwa no gutaka kwabo, bati “Ubutaka butatumira natwe!”

35.text: Umuriro uva imbere y'Uwiteka, ukongora ba bagabo magana abiri na mirongo itanu bosheje imibavu.
